result.summary: The page is largely well-formed; most findings are minor edge clipping and text truncation issues typical of horizontal carousels, plus one content truncation that lacks proper ellipsis handling.

issues.description: The third restaurant name in 'Fastest near you' is truncated as 'Trattoria Piccol' with no ellipsis, making the name look cut off/broken rather than intentionally clipped.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow: ellipsis (or platform equivalent) so truncated names render as 'Trattoria Piccol…', or wrap to a second line.

issues.description: The last category filter chip on the right edge (after 'Healthy') is clipped so severely that its label is completely invisible, appearing as an empty gray sliver.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the horizontal chip carousel spacing or add a peek amount that shows enough of the next chip's label to indicate it is scrollable content, not a rendering glitch.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card ('-20%') is abruptly cut off by the bottom navigation bar with no visible restaurant name or details, which can look broken on first load.
issues.suggestion: Ensure content has adequate bottom padding/safe-area inset so the last card isn't awkwardly bisected by the nav bar, or let a natural fold point show partial image with a hint of the title.

issues.description: The 'See all' links and delivery fee/metadata text use light gray/green on white that may fall below WCAG contrast recommendations for small text.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text and link colors slightly to meet at least 4.5:1 contrast ratio for body-size text.
